provenance.note: HONEST PROVENANCE. Live U.S. DOT video could not be captured from this environment: MDOT CHART video endpoints return HTTP 404, no system ffmpeg is available, and public DOT still-image snapshots refresh far too slowly (~0.1 FPS observed) to reconstruct vehicle trajectories. Per an explicit decision to use a real recorded traffic video rather than fabricate frames, this project runs on a genuinely real, publicly distributed overhead highway-traffic recording.
provenance.scene_type: Fixed elevated (overpass) oblique view of a divided multi-lane highway with a median barrier
provenance.apparent_region: European-style motorway (NOT a U.S. DOT camera); used here as a representative real overhead highway-traffic testbed

us_standard_methods_applied: SAE J2735 Basic Safety Message (MsgID 20) virtual telemetry encoding

calibration.method: Approximate 4-point ground-plane homography from visible lane geometry
calibration.assumed_lane_width_note: Standard highway lane width used to set metric scale; the scene is not U.S., so absolute speeds/emissions are approximate. Ablation claims (count stability, unphysical-acceleration suppression, GEH) are scale-invariant.
calibration.direction_convention: Screen-vertical travel; upstream (far) and downstream (near) gates per carriageway
